judgements.reason: Preparing for calamity is too heavy for a cheerful minor kitchen cut.
About forgiving a sparring partner; only shares the idea of a wound.
Playful cook-and-knife wisdom: slice, don't hack. Fits the light mood.
Poisoned arrow surgery is far too grave for a small cut.
About looking foolish; person isn't embarrassed, just carried on.
General trust in nature; little to do with the mishap.
Pain calls for fortitude; affirms carrying on with dinner.
The finger may complain; I'm not harmed. Matches their shrug.
Sore spot spoiling comfort; person isn't dwelling on it.
Nothing heavy if accepted lightly; kitchen setting, affirms their good humour.
Life works by letting go; a light affirmation of the cancellation.
Liberation from birth and death is too grand for a gym membership.
What I feared to give up is now a joy to part with.
Giving up the lesser for greater joy; fits the relief, a bit lofty.
Superstitions and the eternal soul; only shares the word free.
Released from bonds and knowing it; playful fit for the freedom felt.
About renewing a contest after quitting; pulls against their happy quitting.
Seeing God in others; shares only the idea of freedom.
You'll live without the extra just as easily; less money, less trouble.
Forgetting as freedom; too abstract for this moment.
Other friends can console; make new friends. Useful, slightly stern.
Only names the wound of lost closeness; offers nothing further.
Rejoice you had the friend rather than mourn losing them.
Restates betrayal by a close friend; no way forward.
Don't resent being left by a friend; all must part. Somewhat austere.
Names the grief of a friend turned away; only restates.
Generic comfort about sorrow; not about the friendship.
The friendship isn't erased; the past is yours. Directly answers getting over it.
Lament of friends taken away; restates the pain only.
Close friend's betrayal described; nothing to take away.
Night terrors laughable by day; loose fit for a funny mishap.
Witty fox fable, but about being hunted, not the stolen chicken.
Laughing at loss, but grave imagery is beside the point.
Warns merriment brings sorrow; dampens a harmless laugh.
Laughing at being cheated; only loosely echoes the theft.
Puppies at play, nothing to anger; gentle and dog-themed.
Stolen lamp: the thief did nothing strange. Perfectly wry for a thieving dog.
About irritating conversations; off-target.
Laughter and unkindness don't mix; nice nudge to laugh at the dog.
Funny food fable, but about scaling ambition, not the dog.
Recovery from grave illness; too serious for sore legs.
Weakness from terror; only shares weariness.
Meditation as rest; tangential to post-workout soreness.
Harden the body through hard labour when healthy. Spot on for leg day.
Nightly tears and enemies; wrong register for gym soreness.
Training hurts now, pays later; strengthen feeble knees. Apt and witty.
Refreshing the sorrowful soul; only shares weariness.
Rest is indispensable; a fair nudge to recover.
Weary with sorrow; tone too heavy for the situation.
Rest belongs to work; neat reminder to recover.
About taking offence at insults; not embarrassment.
Social slips matter less than composure and self-content.
Worry about what people say causes needless trouble; useful perspective.
Nature never promised we'd never look ridiculous. Exactly the comfort needed.
Describes the forced smile's discomfort; nothing to take away.
Glad humiliation amid scorn; too lofty for a mistaken wave.
About revilers upsetting you; no one insulted them.
We're all alike in our failings; loose comfort only.
Social clumsiness as sign of nobler character; amusing reassurance.
About confessing mistakes; nothing to confess here.
Spiritual hunger and weeping; too solemn for a curry craving.
About lack of appetite; the opposite situation.
Eat only to sustain the body; preachy for a playful craving.
Get used to plain fare; lecture-like for a light remark.
Cravings cost us dear; mildly scolding for a joke.
Desire as pain; heavier than the mood.
Nothing better than to eat, drink and enjoy. A cheerful yes.
Cooking imagery, but really about suffering as refinement.
Poisoned drink and deadly pain; wrong for a curry craving.
No longing unfulfilled; light, wry promise of curry.
We're allowed to look foolish sometimes; eases the embarrassment.
Nerves before speaking; not the spilled-deck panic.
Test whether the feared trouble is real; directly answers 'boss will kill me'.
A mistake owned and handled properly is accepted; steadying.
Worry about opinion generally; not the practical fix.
Hide until anger passes; amusing but unhelpful before a meeting.
Be poised in this moment; fits the minutes before the meeting.
Dwell on mistakes' enormity; too harsh for a coffee spill.
Things fall apart; carry on diligently. Brief, steadying.
About forced smiles; beside the point.
Wishes for endless tears; restates the weeping only.
Names the wound of loss; offers nothing to carry it.
All have wept for a mother; you are not alone in this.
Augustine on his mother: letting tears flow and finding rest in them.
Tears fall and ease the soul; let them. Directly reassures.
After sleep grief softened a little; hopeful for sleepless nights.
Mourn a day or two then be comforted; feels rushing.
Assumes mourning is finished; would land coldly two weeks in.
Vivid description of grief's darkness; nothing beyond it.
This is my grief and I must bear it; steadying acceptance.
Describes grief's darkness only; no consolation.
Memory stings but holds pleasure; fits loving the dog.
Never forget who you wept with; honours the dog's comfort.
Loss raises 'what after this?'; abstract, no comfort.
Speak of and cherish the departed; gentle and usable.
Lost as if we still have them; tender consolation.
Names the wrench of loss only.
Something remains that does not pass; answers 'last bit of him gone'.
Universal parting; too abstract for this fresh, layered loss.
Those we loved still abide with us; the past is ours. Speaks to the brother link.
Strange parable of dead sorrow; off-target for fresh absence.
Mirrors expecting them to come; restates without consolation.
Speak of and cherish them; gives the quiet something to hold.
Searching the house for her, then finding nothing truly vanishes. Deeply apt.
Names the broken habit of living together; restates only.
Abstract question after loss; not the daily emptiness.
Time slowly patches us up; quiet hope.
Grief's spiritual wave fades; beside the point, slightly deflating.
Same point as above; not about the empty house.
Loss raises soul questions; generic.
Vague comfort about sorrow; misses the guilt and unkindness.
Grieving apart in spirit from family; loosely echoes distance.
Accept calmly, mourning done; dismissive of the conflict.
Assumes a loved, pleasant memory; doesn't fit an unkind parent.
Jacob's inconsolable grief for a beloved son; wrong relationship.
Grief for a dear friend; not mixed grief and guilt.
Mourn as the person deserves, then be comforted; permission for measured grief.
Grief softening after sleep; misses the core conflict.
Despair that the divine doesn't care; unhelpful here.
Loss of a sweet bond; jars with an unkind parent.
Abstract question after loss; nothing to hold.
Calm acceptance, mourning finished; cold for a young widow.
Calls love of perishable things wretched; bleak, near-blaming.
Not just me; all are parted from those they love. Eases isolation.
The one we loved still abides with us; misses the loneliness.
Names the wound of a shared life torn away; restates.
About remembering who you wept with; loosely related.
'No one enjoys a sorrowful person' could sting someone tired of explaining.
Something remains; too abstract for this grief.
Describes grief's darkness; nothing to take away.
